body.prompt: Wide shot inside a large Roman leather command tent at night in the dry eastern provinces, heavy leather walls, wooden tent poles, a rough wooden camp table, a low round fire pit ringed with stones in the middle of the tent glowing with orange flames: seen from directly behind, the Roman emperor Marcus Aurelius at age fifty-four, short curly grey-brown hair, short grey-flecked full beard, deep tired eyes, plain brown wool tunic under a deep crimson wool military cloak fastened with a round bronze brooch stepping alone through the parted tent flap into the tent, his back to the camera, a dark silhouette rimmed with orange firelight, walking toward the table where a dark iron-bound chest waits beside the fire. Photorealistic film still from a prestige epic historical drama, shot on ARRI Alexa with anamorphic lenses, natural skin pores and wrinkles, real wool, leather and bronze textures, volumetric firelight and thin smoke haze, deep teal-black shadows against warm orange firelight, shallow depth of field, subtle 35mm film grain, realistic human hands with five fingers. Not a painting, not an illustration. Horizontal 16:9 widescreen frame, main subject in the middle band of the frame, nothing important in the top and bottom eighth of the frame. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no writing, no logos, no watermark anywhere.
